title: Are any interfaces down right now?

turns.question: Are any interfaces down right now?

turns.answer: On tamarack-gw, one link is actually down — sfp-sfpplus2, the second bond link to core-sw — showing a not-connected state, while its partner sfp-sfpplus1 is up and passing traffic. The other offline ports, ether1, sfp-sfpplus3, sfp-sfpplus4, and the two sfp28 ports, are just unused, not errors. Everything carrying real traffic, including the internet uplinks and the basswood backhaul, looks healthy with no errors.
